summary: Calibration is applied before physical measurements, Leica parsing and specimen/series matching are explicit, checkpoint identity is enforced, and the cited pilot artifacts contain valid per-specimen Leica calibration. Acceptance is nevertheless blocked because production defaults permit silent fallback when Leica metadata is missing or unparseable, manifest validation can accept those fallback values, and generated provenance does not hash or copy the source Leica XML, image stack, or ROI source. The repeated 2D ROI is presented as a sampled geometric volume rather than anatomical organ volume, but some reporting language remains insufficiently explicit about extrusion of the same 2D mask through Z.

findings.title: Production permits stale calibration fallback when Leica metadata is expected
findings.impact: A missing, malformed, or undiscovered Leica XML can leave configured fallback XY/Z scales active while the run continues. Every downstream physical threshold and measurement can then be scaled using stale values, contrary to the explicit audit rule that such fallback is blocking when metadata exists.
evidence: production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:104-106 sets REQUIRE_LEICA_METADATA=false.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11187-11204 continues with fallback scales after Leica XML is unavailable or unparseable.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11886-11988 does not make fallback or metadata parse warnings invalid during study-manifest validation.
findings.recommendation: For Leica-named sources, require successful specimen-matched XML parsing in production. Reject missing, ambiguous, or malformed XML before segmentation, and require an explicit, auditable override for genuinely non-Leica inputs.

findings.title: Run artifacts do not freeze calibration and source identity sufficiently for reproduction
findings.impact: The cited pilot cannot be independently reconstructed from archived settings alone because the exact Leica XML, image bytes, ROI, and exclusion-mask sources are not content-addressed. Absolute external paths can change while recorded calibration values remain unchanged.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11255-11287 saves resolved values but no metadata-source digest.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11318-11415 omits source TIFF and mask digests from the settings manifest.

scratch/v571_final_production_pilot/KJ-01/settings/settings_manifest.json and scratch/v571_final_production_pilot/WT-01/settings/settings_manifest.json omit source-stack, ROI, exclusion-mask, and Leica XML hashes.
findings.recommendation: Archive or hash the matched Leica XML, every source TIFF in ordered Z/channel sequence, the ROI source, and the exclusion mask. Record specimen/Project/Series/channel/Z mapping and verify those hashes before resume or reproduction.

findings.title: Repeated 2D ROI extrusion is not explicitly disclaimed in reports
findings.impact: Readers can interpret `sampled ROI volume` and `tissue area` as anatomical sampling geometry, although the implementation repeats one 2D mask through Z. This conflicts with the stated non-claim that existing ROIs do not establish anatomical SV volume.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:12065-12096 computes volume from one ROI area multiplied by nominal sampled depth.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:12655-12668 and 12774-12778 use volume terminology without an explicit non-anatomical repeated-mask disclaimer.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:12767-12771 calls the ROI footprint tissue area.
findings.recommendation: Rename the quantity to `2D ROI extrusion sampling denominator`, state that the identical 2D ROI is repeated through Z, and explicitly say it is not anatomical tissue, SV, or organ volume wherever the metric appears.

findings.title: Older tuning settings bundles contain a stale profile copy
findings.impact: The WT-01 tuning bundle points to the current production-profile path but archives a different profile revision, so it must not be treated as evidence for the current production profile.

limitations: Focused pytest execution was unavailable because the active Python environment reported `No module named pytest`; test source and named coverage were inspected but not executed.
No full image stack was run, as required by the review instructions.
External Leica XML and TIFF contents were not independently re-read; assessment used repository code and generated artifacts.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
recommended_follow_up: Make Leica metadata failure fatal for Leica-named production stacks and add adversarial tests for missing XML, malformed XML, wrong Project/Series XML, and stale manifest calibration.
Extend settings manifests with SHA-256 hashes and ordered identities for Leica XML, TIFFs, ROI, exclusion mask, profile, and checkpoint.
Add explicit report language distinguishing repeated-2D-ROI extrusion exposure from anatomical 3D organ volume.
Run the focused calibration, checkpoint, settings-bundle, ROI/channel/Z, and fallback tests in the repository's documented test environment, then create a superseding append-only audit run.
